milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to within 5 blocks of the blue concrete powder trail midpoint at (~5,0,4) and face toward it. Max distance reduced from 16 to 5 to prevent triggering at spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~6.4 blocks), ensuring the player actually walked to the trail. Facing tolerance of 60° confirms visual observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted pink tulip is elevated on a cobblestone pedestal at (~10,1,5) just outside the house entrance. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player navigated past the blue trail to reach the house entrance area. Target y=1 reflects the tulip's elevated position on the pedestal. Facing tolerance of 60° confirms the player is looking at the tulip.

Uses position_near_with_facing because talking to a villager requires approaching and facing them to right-click and open the interaction/trade GUI. The farmer villager is at (~10,1,8) inside the house with NoAI. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player entered or is at the house entrance (villager is 3 blocks inside from the entrance at z=6). Facing tolerance of 60° confirms the player is oriented toward the villager.

Uses inventory_has because trading for Pumpkin Pie results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 pumpkin pie and 16 emeralds. A successful trade (4 emeralds → 4 pumpkin pie) will put at least 1 pumpkin pie in inventory. This is the most direct and reliable check for confirming a completed trade transaction.
